findings.evidence: "The stipend clock resumes on their first day back."
findings.fix: Specify what resumes: "Employees regain eligibility on their first day back" or "The benefit year resets on their first day back."
findings.violation: "Stipend clock" is ambiguous - unclear whether it refers to the 90-day waiting period, the benefit year, or something else.

findings.evidence: "However, an incomplete request pauses the timeline until the missing item arrives."
findings.fix: Specify what may be missing: "However, an incomplete request pauses the timeline until the requester provides the missing documentation."
findings.violation: "Missing item" is vague - does not clarify whether documentation, receipts, or other information is needed.

findings.evidence: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition and we may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.fix: Rewrite in third person: "Employees must keep their equipment in good working condition and the IT asset group may request a brief photo check once a year."
findings.violation: Inconsistent voice - the document uses third person throughout ("employees," "manager," "finance office") but this sentence shifts to second person ("You," "we").

findings.evidence: "You record the stipend item on the request form... Also, you submit the request in the portal. You track its status there until the payment clears."
findings.fix: Rewrite in third person: "Employees record the stipend item on the request form and submit the request in the portal, then track its status there until payment clears."
findings.violation: Inconsistent voice - uses second person ("You record," "you submit," "You track") while the document is written in third person elsewhere.

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."
findings.fix: Remove the comma and either expand to match "How to Apply" or clarify this is a summary: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility and uploading the receipt."
findings.violation: Vague and incomplete description compared to detailed steps in "How to Apply;" also contains awkward comma placement before "and" with only two items.

findings.evidence: Program Overview: "tracks the equipment catalog on the first business day of the month." Special Cases: "publishes the equipment catalog at the start of the fiscal year."
findings.fix: Clarify whether updates occur monthly, annually, or both; revise both sections to reflect the same schedule.
findings.location: Program Overview and Special Cases sections
findings.violation: Contradictory timing - one section indicates monthly updates, another indicates annual updates at fiscal year start.

findings.evidence: Three different entities mentioned: "IT asset group tracks" (Program Overview), "finance liaison publishes" (Special Cases), "benefits team reviews" (Questions and Updates).
findings.fix: Define the specific role of each team (e.g., "IT asset group maintains," "finance liaison reviews," "benefits team distributes") or consolidate responsibility to one owner.
findings.location: Program Overview, Special Cases, and Questions and Updates sections
findings.violation: Unclear which entity is responsible for managing the equipment catalog, creating confusion about roles and accountability.
